name: 地区GMV
query: 统计 2025 年第一季度各大区的 GMV，并按 GMV 从高到低排序
expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.order_amount) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r USING(region_id) WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(o.order_amount) DESC

actual.sql: SELECT dr.region_name AS 地区, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order AS fo JOIN dim_region AS dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date AS dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.date_id >= 20250101 AND dd.date_id <= 20250331 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY dr.region_name ORDER BY GMV DESC LIMIT 500

name: 品类销量销售额
query: 统计 2025 年 3 月各商品品类的销量和销售额
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.order_quantity), SUM(o.order_amount) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p USING(product_id) WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250301 AND 20250331 GROUP BY p.category

actual.sql: SELECT dp.category AS 品类, SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS 销量, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order AS fo JOIN dim_product AS dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date AS dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month = 3 GROUP BY dp.category ORDER BY SUM(fo.order_amount) DESC LIMIT 500

name: 地区商品排行
query: 查询华东地区 2025 年第一季度销售额最高的前 5 个商品
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.order_amount) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p USING(product_id) JOIN dim_region r USING(region_id) WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(o.order_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

actual.sql: SELECT dp.product_name AS 商品名称, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order AS fo JOIN dim_region AS dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_product AS dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date AS dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华东' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY dp.product_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 5

name: 会员订单销售额
query: 按会员等级统计 2025 年第一季度的订单数和销售额
expected_sql: SELECT c.member_level, COUNT(*), SUM(o.order_amount) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_customer c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY c.member_level

actual.sql: SELECT dc.member_level AS 会员等级, COUNT(fo.order_amount) AS 订单数, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order AS fo JOIN dim_customer AS dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id JOIN dim_date AS dd ON CAST(fo.date_id AS CHAR) = CAST(dd.date_id AS CHAR) WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY dc.member_level ORDER BY 会员等级 LIMIT 500

name: 客单价
query: 2025年第一季度的客单价是多少？保留两位小数
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),2) FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331

actual.sql: SELECT CONCAT(dd.year, '年', dd.quarter) AS 季度, ROUND(AVG(fo.order_amount), 2) AS 客单价 FROM fact_order AS fo JOIN dim_date AS dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY dd.year, dd.quarter LIMIT 500
